description: How often would buyer-agent models pick my x402 offer? One signed number: its chance of being picked against the offers models saw in a category's latest Machine Choice Benchmark layouts, at your price, payers, slot and discovery metadata, from a choice model fitted to every benchmark trial (no model call), with its 95% range and what each feature is worth in percent of price. Answers once the model is checked on 100 held-out picks, in a category with 30 priced decisions. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.005 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
